games.scene: A cheerful streamlined toy rocket racing along a curving luminous space track through three big floating number gates marked 12, 24, 36 in that exact order. One big rocket in foreground, a golden finish star, deep space, mathematical racing energy.

games.title: Mantiq labirinti
games.scene: A prominent isometric square labyrinth with thick turquoise walls on dark teal base. One glossy orange ball follows a glowing clean route toward a large golden star at exit. Full maze corners visible. Clear route decision, a single hero ball and star, avoid busy microdetails.

games.title: Internet qahramoni

games.title: Kasrlar oshxonasi
games.scene: A colorful toy kitchen fraction puzzle: a large pizza divided cleanly into four equal quarters on a round board, one quarter held just above its empty space by a cartoon spatula. Two large cream fraction tiles read 1/4 and 3/4. A sliced orange and rolling pin secondary, clear mathematical parts-of-whole.

games.title: So‘z ovchisi

games.title: Algoritm ustasi
games.scene: Three prominent chunky command tiles numbered 1, 2, 3 connected by luminous arrows form a clear path from a small orange robot to a golden target. A floating ordered step staircase and a code puzzle platform show sequence logic; simple coherent algorithm, no complex flowchart.

games.title: Xotira kartalari

Two face-up cards show identical orange star icons, a second matching pair shows identical mint apples; two cards are face down with simple violet patterns. One card flips with a curved trail, instantly obvious matching-pairs game.

games.title: Sensorlar olami
games.scene: A friendly small cream robot with orange face rim and two large expressive sensor eyes scans a nearby orange obstacle. Three clean translucent scanning arcs, one prominent toy distance sensor module with two round lenses, a small glowing light sensor. Educational sensing playground, no complex circuit text.

games.title: Klaviatura ustasi
games.scene: A dramatic close-up toy mechanical keyboard with chunky bright keys, recognizable A S D F letters and a large ENTER key with return arrow. One orange key is pressed and glows; colorful curved typing trails lead to a small screen with one clean checkmark. No hands needed, focus keyboard mastery.

games.title: Ranglar olami

games.title: Kosmik hisob

games.title: Takrorlash sehri

One large looping arrow encircles the scene with a small x3 badge; code loop magic, no wizard or invented combat.

games.title: Robot konstruktor
games.scene: An adorable cream robot with orange visor rim being assembled in an inviting toy workshop: completed torso and head centered, one arm and two wheels floating in a tidy exploded assembly alignment, large wrench to side. Parts visibly fit, no random mechanical junk, happy mint eyes.

games.title: Fayllar shahri

games.title: Gap tuzuvchi

games.title: Naqshlar siri
games.scene: A clear playful sequence of chunky 3D shapes: coral circle, mint triangle, coral circle, mint triangle, empty outlined circle slot. A matching coral circle floats above the empty slot ready to finish it. Small checker-pattern floor reinforces patterns, bold simple logic game composition.

games.title: Robot sayohati

Foreground robot hero holds a small map, path choices and adventure, no command tile emphasis to distinguish robot control game.
